name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 ホワイトライダー

description.ja: 「ペイルライダー計画」
description.en: "Pale Rider Plan"

description.ja: RX-80WR
description.en: RX-80WR

description.ja: ホ ワ イ ト ラ イ ダ ー、 キ ッ ト 化 ！
description.en: White Rider now available as a kit!

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム バトルオペレーション Code Fairy』より、「ペイルライダー計画」で開発された試作１号機ホワイトライダーをＨＧシリーズで立体化。
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation Code Fairy ", the first prototype White Rider developed in the " Pale Rider Project" is made into a three-dimensional model in the HG series.

description.ja: ＨＧ ペイルライダーをベースに形状、カラーリングを再現。専用武装”試作型シェキナー”など、特徴的な武装類を新規造形で再現。
description.en: Reproduce the shape and coloring based on HG Pale Rider. Characteristic weapons such as the special weapon "Prototype Shekinah" are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　火器管制システムと大型兵装を搭載した実験機
description.en: ● Experimental aircraft equipped with a fire control system and large weapons.

description.ja: 印象的な頭部をはじめ、胸部、腕部、腰部などホワイトライダーの形状を新規造形を交え再現。
description.en: The White Rider's shape, including the impressive head, chest, arms, and waist, has been recreated with new modeling.

description.ja: 頭部
description.en: head

description.ja: 印象的な王冠を被ったような頭部を新規造形で再現。
description.en: The head, which looks like it's wearing an impressive crown, has been recreated with new modeling.

description.ja: 腕部
description.en: arm

description.ja: 左腕グレネード・ランチャーを新規パーツで再現。
description.en: Reproduce the left arm grenade launcher with new parts.

description.ja: 胸部・腰部
description.en: Chest/lumbar region

description.ja: 胸部装甲、フロントアーマー、リアアーマーの形状を新規再現。
description.en: Newly reproduced shapes of chest armor, front armor, and rear armor.

description.ja: 背部
description.en: back

description.ja: 試作型シェキナー用接続アーム及びウイングを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The connecting arm and wing for the prototype Shekinah are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ウイングは展開ギミックを搭載。
description.en: The wing is equipped with a deployment gimmick.

description.ja: ●　専用武装「試作型シェキナー」、「ヒート・レイピア」を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the special weapons "Prototype Shekinah " and " Heat Rapier" with new modeling!

description.ja: 試作型シェキナー
description.en: Prototype Shekinah

description.ja: 複合型特殊武装 シェキナーの試作型となる専用武装を新規造形で再現。
description.en: Composite special armament The special armament that is the prototype of Shekinah is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: 新規接続アームの可動により右腕への装着が可能。
description.en: The new connecting arm is movable so it can be attached to the right arm.

description.ja: パーツの差し替えで、メガ・ビーム・ランチャー砲撃形態を再現可能。
description.en: By replacing parts, the Mega Beam Launcher bombardment mode can be reproduced.

description.ja: 砲撃形態時の放熱発光状態をシールの選択で表現可能。
description.en: The heat dissipation light emission state during bombardment mode can be expressed by selecting Seal.

description.ja: ヒート・レイピア
description.en: heat rapier

description.ja: 専用近接武装ヒート・レイピアを新規造形で付属。腰部へのマウントが可能。
description.en: A new model of the exclusive close-range weapon Heat Rapier is included. Can be mounted on the waist.

description.ja: ●　ＺＥＵＳ発動時の姿を再現可能！
description.en: ● It is possible to reproduce the appearance when ZEUS is activated!

description.ja: ノーマル状態、ＺＥＵＳ発動状態が、シールの選択で再現可能。
description.en: Normal state and ZEUS activation state can be reproduced by selecting Seal.

description.ja: ●　部隊エンブレムマークなどを収録したシールが付属
description.en: ● Seal containing unit emblem marks etc. is included.

description.ja: 付属武装：試作型シェキナー ／ ヒート・レイピア
description.en: Attached weapons: Prototype Shekinah / Heat Rapier

description.ja: １／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：８才以上
description.en: Target age: 8 years old and above

description.ja: 製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ

description.ja: ・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません
